title: Utilization Management Program Prior Authorization Drug List and Diagnosis Coding
content:
Under the Utilization Management Program, a drug needs a prior authorization approval before it is covered when it appears on the prior authorization list of the member's review package. The list grows with the package rank; every drug on a lower package's list stays on the higher packages' lists.

| Review package | Drugs that need prior authorization |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Clinical Essentials | Wegovy, Zepbound, Humira, adalimumab-adaz, Dupixent, Skyrizi, Rinvoq, Enbrel, Ibrance |
| Northbridge Clinical Standard | the Essentials list, plus Ozempic and Mounjaro |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced | the Standard list, plus Nurtec ODT and Ubrelvy |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced Plus | the same list as Northbridge Clinical Advanced |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive | the Advanced Plus list, plus Breztri Aerosphere |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive Specialty | the same list as Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive |

Written out in full for the two broadest packages, the list is: Wegovy, Zepbound, Humira, adalimumab-adaz, Dupixent, Skyrizi, Rinvoq, Enbrel, Ibrance, Ozempic, Mounjaro, Nurtec ODT, Ubrelvy and Breztri Aerosphere.

## Diagnosis codes and criteria (all six packages)

| Term | Every package |
|---|---|
| Drugs whose review requires an ICD-10-CM diagnosis code on the case | Ozempic, Mounjaro, Wegovy, Zepbound |
| Off-label use approvable only with support in a recognized compendium | Yes |
| Clinical criteria the reviews apply | Northbridge Rx's own clinical policy (the Northbridge clinical policy criteria) |

### Points of judgement

- Ozempic is on the prior authorization list from Northbridge Clinical Standard upward; on Northbridge Clinical Essentials it is not listed for prior authorization, although a review of it, where one is held, still requires a diagnosis code.
- Nurtec ODT and Ubrelvy need prior authorization only from Northbridge Clinical Advanced upward.
- Breztri Aerosphere needs prior authorization only on the two Comprehensive packages.
